entities.name: Francisco de Valdez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Valdez was a Spanish general during the Eighty Years War. He had command over the besieging forces of the Army of Flanders during the Siege of Leiden commencing in 1573 and led the failed attack on the city of Delft the same year.
